verdict.rationale: Typesense's docs describe it as optimized for instant, typically sub-50ms, search-as-you-type experiences, and the vendor runs live as-you-type demos over 2.2M recipes and 32M songs. It also ships Search UI components for wiring results to keystrokes. Community users independently praise its instant search queries and call it a good fit for instant-search behavior. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on latency measurements confirming the millisecond figures, and in-depth docs on per-keystroke (prefix) query configuration.
